topic: Scientific Models and Particle Model of Matter
key_concepts: A scientific model is a simplified representation of a complex idea, system, or process
Physical, mathematical, and conceptual models serve different purposes in science
Scientific models help visualize invisible phenomena, predict events, and test ideas safel
Scientific models have limitations and may be revised as new discoveries emerge
Matter is anything that has mass and takes up space
All matter is made of tiny particles that are always in motion
Particles may be single atoms or groups of atoms called molecules
Particle arrangement and movement differ in solids, liquids, and gases
Forces between particles are strongest in solids and weakest in gases
Increasing temperature makes particles move faster and can change the state of matter
Spaces between particles help explain the behavior of different states of matter
